mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.attendance.selectAttendance */ RECORD_ID as recordId, SESSION_ID as sessionId, NAME as name, EMAIL as email, IP_ADDRESS as ipAddress, JOIN_TIME as joinTime, LEAVE_TIME as leaveTime FROM ATTENDANCE_RECORD WHERE RECORD_ID = #{recordId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.attendance.selectListCountAttendance */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM ATTENDANCE_RECORD WHERE 1=1
AND SESSION_ID like '%${scSessionId}%'
AND NAME like '%${scName}%'
AND EMAIL like '%${scEmail}%'
AND JOIN_TIME like '%${scJoinTime}%'

SELECT #{scSessionId} as session_id, COUNT(*) as record_id, /* 총 참여자 수 */ COUNT(leave_time) as name, /* 퇴장 완료자 수 */ COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN 1 END) as email, /* 현재 참여중 */ ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, join_time, leave_time) ELSE NULL END), 1) as participation_minutes, /* 평균 참여시간 */ DATE_FORMAT(MIN(join_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as join_time, /* 세션 시작시간 */ DATE_FORMAT(MAX(leave_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as leave_time /* 마지막 퇴장시간 */ FROM attendance_records WHERE 1=1
AND session_id = #{scSessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_records SET leave_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND leave_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT record_id, session_id, name, email, ip_address, DATE_FORMAT(join_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as join_time, DATE_FORMAT(leave_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as leave_time, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, join_time, leave_time) ELSE NULL END as participation_minutes, CASE WHEN leave_time IS NULL THEN '참여중' ELSE '퇴장완료' END as status FROM attendance_records WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY join_time ASC

SELECT a1.record_id, a1.session_id, a1.name, a1.email, DATE_FORMAT(a1.join_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as join_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, (SELECT MIN(join_time) FROM attendance_records a2 WHERE a2.session_id = a1.session_id), a1.join_time ) as participation_minutes /* 지각 시간(분) */ FROM attendance_records a1 WHERE a1.session_id = #{sessionId} AND a1.join_time > ( SELECT DATE_ADD(MIN(join_time), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) FROM attendance_records a2 WHERE a2.session_id = a1.session_id ) ORDER BY a1.join_time
